shard.title: Scale signature: yes_no
shard.basis: variables with this scale signature in the current release (7224r3a)

name: artsout
label: OUTDOOR ART ACTIVITY IN PAST 12 MONTHS

questions.text:
Thinking about all the types of events you said you attended, were any of those activities outdoors?

NOTE: This variable originates on the NEA follow-on, and should not be analyzed without the NEA-specific weights WTSSPS_NEA or WTSSNRPS_NEA

name: yrcreat
label: CREATE ART IN PAST 12 MONTHS

questions.text:
(During the last 12 months, did you...) create or perform art of your own? This may have included music, theater, or dance; creative writing; crafts or visual arts; digital art; or film or photography done for artistic purposes.

NOTE: This variable originates on the NEA follow-on, and should not be analyzed without the NEA-specific weights WTSSPS_NEA or WTSSNRPS_NEA

name: yrrdg
label: READ FICTION OR POETRY IN PAST 12 MONTHS

questions.text:
(During the last 12 months, did you...) read any novels or short stories, poetry, or plays?

NOTE: This variable originates on the NEA follow-on, and should not be analyzed without the NEA-specific weights WTSSPS_NEA or WTSSNRPS_NEA

name: yrtour
label: ONLINE ART TOUR IN PAST 12 MONTHS

questions.text:
The following questions are about arts events or activities you may have watched or listened to, using digital technology, during the last 12 months. (During the last 12 months, did you...) visit or tour an online art museum, gallery, or exhibit?

NOTE: This variable originates on the NEA follow-on, and should not be analyzed without the NEA-specific weights WTSSPS_NEA or WTSSNRPS_NEA

name: yrstmus
label: LIVESTREAMED MUSIC OR THEATER IN PAST 12 MONTHS

questions.text:
(During the last 12 months, did you...) watch or listen to a live-streamed event featuring a music, theater, or dance performance?

NOTE: This variable originates on the NEA follow-on, and should not be analyzed without the NEA-specific weights WTSSPS_NEA or WTSSNRPS_NEA

name: yrarmus
label: ARCHIVED LIVESTREAMED MUSIC OR THEATER IN PAST 12 MONTHS

questions.text:
(During the last 12 months, did you...) watch or listen to an archived web event featuring a music, theater, or dance performance? This may have included video or audio clips on, for example, YouTube, an organization's website, or a social media platform.

NOTE: This variable originates on the NEA follow-on, and should not be analyzed without the NEA-specific weights WTSSPS_NEA or WTSSNRPS_NEA

name: yrstpo
label: LIVESTREAMED READING EVENT IN PAST 12 MONTHS

name: yrarpo
label: ARCHIVED LIVESTREAMED READING EVENT IN PAST 12 MONTHS

questions.text:
(During the last 12 months, did you...) watch or listen to an archived web event featuring poetry, book-reading, or storytelling? This may have included video or audio clips on, for example, YouTube, an organization's website, or a social media platform.

NOTE: This variable originates on the NEA follow-on, and should not be analyzed without the NEA-specific weights WTSSPS_NEA or WTSSNRPS_NEA

name: yrclass
label: ONLINE CLASS IN PAST 12 MONTHS

questions.text:
(During the last 12 months, did you...) take any online classes or lessons -- or watch instructional videos -- on creating or performing art? This may have included music, theater, or dance; creative writing; crafts or visual arts; digital art; or filmmaking or photography done for artistic purposes.

NOTE: This variable originates on the NEA follow-on, and should not be analyzed without the NEA-specific weights WTSSPS_NEA or WTSSNRPS_NEA

name: yrpod
label: LISTEN TO ART PODCASTS IN PAST 12 MONTHS

name: kidsund18
label: ANY KIDS UNDER 18 IN HH

questions.text:
This section contains questions about you and your household. We are interested in understanding what households in the United States look like and we are grateful for any information you provide.
Are there any individuals aged 0 to 17 years old living at this household?

name: lngrltnshp
label: R IN LONG-TERM RELATIONSHIP IN HH

questions.text:
These next questions are about your relationships with other individuals in your household who are 18 or older.
	Are you married to, partnered with, or otherwise in a long-term relationship with another individual 18 or older who lives in this household?

name: rsblng18
label: R HAS SIBLING IN HH

label: R IS CHILD OF ANOTHER ADULT IN HH

label: R IS BIOLOGICAL PARENT OF ANOTHER ADULT IN HH

questions.text: To clarify, are you the biological parent of at least one individual 18 or older in your household?

name: radptprnt18
label: R IS ADOPTED PARENT OF ANOTHER ADULT IN HH

questions.text: To clarify, are you the adoptive parent of at least one individual 18 or older in your household?

name: rstpprnt18
